correctness.rationale: For Rozikov non-mirror q5 reduction k2 with x>0, τ>2, x≠1 and eta_tau(x)>0, the sextic ζ_tau determines solutions. Independently recomputed symbolic discriminant 4096(τ²−9τ+19)(τ²+τ−1)R((τ−2)²) and constant resultant Res_x(ζ,2−τx+τx²−x³)=64; Sturm root counts at τ=3,4,6,8 are 0,2,4,6, and R has one positive root w*. Thus only τ±=(9±sqrt(5))/2 and τ*=2+sqrt(w*)≈7.11925832 change counts for τ>2. The collision at τ± is x=1 a double root, hence excluded; the τ* collision is one positive nontrivial double root, giving 5 distinct there. Resultant excludes eta=0, and all six positive roots at τ8 have eta>0, which propagates across connected root branches. Therefore Nτ=0 for (2,τ-], 2 for (τ-,τ+], 4 for (τ+,τ*), 5 at τ*, 6 for >τ*. The source branch excludes other q5 solutions, not an all-GGM classification.
